question: M, N and O alone can complete a work in 10, 12 and 15 days respectively. In how many days M, N and O together can complete 1/6 of the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by M to complete the work = 10 days

Time taken by N to complete the work = 12 days

Time taken by O to complete the work = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Work done per day by M, N, and O together = (Work done by M per day) + (Work done by N per day) + (Work done by O per day)

Time taken to complete a fraction of the work = Fraction of the work / (Work done per day by M, N, and O together)

**Calculation:**

Work done per day by M = 1/10
